user.title: Govee Management
user.description: Paste your personal Govee API key. Get one in the Govee Home app: User → About Us → Request API Key. It arrives by email within seconds.

data_description.api_key: Used for the REST API and as both the username and password for Govee's push stream. It is stored only in Home Assistant.

devices.title: Choose devices
devices.description: Found {count} devices on this Govee account. Tick the ones to track. You can change this later, and pick up devices added afterwards, without re-entering your key.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Govee Management
reauth_confirm.description: Govee rejected the stored API key. Paste a current one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Govee API. Check Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.
error.rate_limited: Govee is rate limiting this key. Wait a minute and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Govee account is already set up.
abort.no_devices: This Govee account has no devices the integration can use.
abort.wrong_account: That key belongs to a different Govee account. Use the key for the account already set up.

devices.title: Devices to track
devices.description: Re-read from your Govee account: {count} devices available, newly found since last time: {new}. Tick the ones to track. Unticking a device removes it and its entities.

polling.title: Polling
polling.description: How often to poll temperature, humidity and air quality over REST. Leak events arrive by push and are unaffected. Govee rate limits the free API, so 60 seconds is the floor.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Govee API to refresh the device list. Try again in a moment.
abort.invalid_auth: Govee rejected the stored API key. Reconfigure the integration to enter a new one.
abort.no_devices: This Govee account has no devices the integration can use.

confirm.title: Track this device?
confirm.description: {name} appeared on your Govee account and is not being tracked yet. Submit to create its entities. If you would rather leave it out, ignore this notification - it will not come back for this device.

abort.entry_gone: The Govee Management entry this device belonged to has been removed.
